# Commands

<!-- Generated by `kanavos-cli commands --markdown`; do not edit by hand. -->

Every change to a Kanavos document is a command (ADR-0005). The same commands are used by the interface, the [control protocol](control-protocol.md) (`command.run`, `command.batch`), the MCP server (`run_command`) and command scripts (`kanavos-cli run script.jsonl project.kanavos`, one command per line). A command's JSON form is `{"name": "<command>", "args": {…}}`.

Units are SI: lengths in metres, areas in m², angles in radians unless an argument says degrees; plan points are `[x, y]` (x east, y north); ids are integers. Arguments with a default may be left out. `command.list` returns the full JSON schema of every command, including the shared types listed at the end.

| Command | Ελληνικά | English | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [`project.set_info`](#projectset_info) | Στοιχεία έργου | Project information | Replaces the project information (title block data). |
| [`site.set`](#siteset) | Οικόπεδο και όροι δόμησης | Plot and building terms | Replaces the whole site: plot, street and building lines, building terms, georeferencing, terrain. |
| [`site.set_plot`](#siteset_plot) | Όρια οικοπέδου | Plot boundary | Sets or removes the plot boundary, keeping the rest of the site. |
| [`site.set_terms`](#siteset_terms) | Όροι δόμησης | Building terms | Sets the building terms, keeping the rest of the site. |
| [`defaults.set`](#defaultsset) | Προεπιλογές στοιχείων | Element defaults | Sets the default build-ups and materials used by tools. |
| [`storey.create`](#storeycreate) | Νέο επίπεδο | New storey | Adds a storey and its plan view. |

| [`storey.delete`](#storeydelete) | Διαγραφή επιπέδου | Delete storey | Removes a storey with all its elements and its plan view. |
| [`storey.duplicate`](#storeyduplicate) | Αντιγραφή επιπέδου | Duplicate storey | Copies a storey with its elements, by default directly above it. |
| [`material.create`](#materialcreate) | Νέο υλικό | New material | Adds a material. |
| [`material.update`](#materialupdate) | Αλλαγή υλικού | Change material | Replaces a material. |
| [`material.delete`](#materialdelete) | Διαγραφή υλικού | Delete material | Removes an unused material. |
| [`material.duplicate`](#materialduplicate) | Αντιγραφή υλικού | Duplicate material | Copies a material under a new name. |

## batch

### `batch`

Πολλαπλή αλλαγή · Multiple changes

Runs several commands as one undo step. Fails as a whole if any command fails.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `commands` | array of `AnyCommand` | yes | Commands in order. |
| `label` | string |  | Label shown in the history, e.g. "Περίγραμμα τοίχων". Default: `""`. |

Example:

```json
{"name":"batch","args":{"commands":[{"args":{"kind":{"height":3.2,"material":1,"position":[0.24,0.24],"profile":{"depth":0.3,"type":"rectangle","width":0.3},"type":"column"},"storey":28},"name":"element.create"},{"args":{"kind":{"height":3.2,"material":1,"position":[11.76,0.24],"profile":{"depth":0.3,"type":"rectangle","width":0.3},"type":"column"},"storey":28},"name":"element.create"}],"label":"Περίγραμμα"}}
```

## build_up

### `build_up.create`

Νέα διαστρωμάτωση · New build-up

Adds a build-up.

Adds a build-up (its `id` is ignored and assigned).

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `build_up` | `BuildUp` | yes | The build-up. |

Example:

```json
{"name":"build_up.create","args":{"build_up":{"id":0,"layers":[{"material":5,"thickness":0.01},{"material":3,"thickness":0.1},{"core":true,"material":2,"thickness":0.25},{"material":5,"thickness":0.02}],"name":"Τοίχος 25 με θερμοπρόσοψη 10","usage":"wall"}}}
```

### `build_up.update`

Αλλαγή διαστρωμάτωσης · Change build-up

Replaces a build-up; elements using it update automatically.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `build_up` | `BuildUp` | yes | The build-up, with the id of the one to replace. |

Example:

```json
{"name":"build_up.update","args":{"build_up":{"id":21,"layers":[{"material":5,"thickness":0.02},{"core":true,"material":2,"thickness":0.1},{"material":5,"thickness":0.02}],"name":"Εσωτερικός τοίχος δρομικός 10","usage":"wall"}}}
```

### `build_up.delete`

Διαγραφή διαστρωμάτωσης · Delete build-up

Removes an unused build-up.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `Id` | yes | Build-up. |

Example:

```json
{"name":"build_up.delete","args":{"id":22}}
```

### `build_up.duplicate`

Αντιγραφή διαστρωμάτωσης · Duplicate build-up

Copies a build-up under a new name.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `Id` | yes | Build-up to copy. |
| `locale` | `Locale` |  | Language of the default name. Default: `"el"`. |
| `name` | string or null |  | Name of the copy; default "<name> - αντίγραφο". |

Example:

```json
{"name":"build_up.duplicate","args":{"id":19,"name":"Εξωτερικός τοίχος με θερμοπρόσοψη 10"}}
```

### `defaults.set`

Προεπιλογές στοιχείων · Element defaults

## dimension

### `dimension.auto`

Αυτόματες διαστάσεις · Automatic dimensions

Adds exterior dimension chains on the four sides of a storey's walls: corners and the jambs of doors and windows, then the overall size.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `offset` | `Length` |  | Distance from the outer wall faces to the first chain (default 1.00 m). Default: `1.0`. |
| `openings` | boolean |  | Include door and window jambs (default true). Default: `true`. |
| `overall` | boolean |  | Add the overall-size chain (default true). Default: `true`. |
| `spacing` | `Length` |  | Distance between chains (default 0.70 m). Default: `0.7`. |
| `storey` | `Id` | yes | Storey. |

Example:

```json
{"name":"dimension.auto","args":{"offset":1.2,"spacing":0.7,"storey":28}}
```

## element

### `element.create`

Νέο στοιχείο · New element

Adds any element: wall, slab, opening, stair, annotation.

Adds any element: walls, slabs, openings, stairs, annotation …

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` | `ElementKind` | yes | Type-specific data. |
| `phase` | `Phase` |  | Construction status. Default: `"new"`. |
| `properties` | object |  | Free user properties. Default: `{}`. |
| `storey` | `Id` or null |  | Storey (required for building parts and plan annotation). |
| `tag` | string |  | User mark. Default: `""`. |
| `view` | `Id` or null |  | Owning section/elevation view, for annotation drawn there. |

Example:

```json
{"name":"element.create","args":{"kind":{"end":[0,10],"height":3.2,"reference":"left","start":[0,0],"structure":{"build_up":19,"type":"layered"},"type":"wall"},"storey":28,"tag":"Τ1"}}
```

### `element.update`

Αλλαγή στοιχείου · Change element

Changes an element; only the given fields change.

Changes an element. Only the given fields change; `kind` replaces all type data.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `Id` | yes | Element. |
| `kind` | `ElementKind` or null |  | New type data (must be the same type). |
| `phase` | `Phase` or null |  | New phase. |
| `properties` | object or null |  | New properties. |
| `storey` | `Id` or null |  | New storey. |
| `tag` | string or null |  | New tag. |

Example:

```json
{"name":"element.update","args":{"id":120,"properties":{"κατασκευαστής":"—"},"tag":"Θ1"}}
```

### `element.delete`

Διαγραφή · Delete

Removes elements and the openings their walls host.

Removes elements (and the openings their walls host).

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ids` | array of `Id` | yes | Elements. |

Example:

```json
{"name":"element.delete","args":{"ids":[120,121]}}
```

### `element.transform`

Μετασχηματισμός · Transform

Moves, rotates or mirrors elements, optionally as copies (`count` copies form an array).  Openings move with their host wall. An opening selected without its host slides along the wall by the move's component along the wall.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `copy` | boolean |  | Make copies instead of moving. Default: `false`. |
| `count` | integer |  | Number of copies when `copy` is set (each one transformed once more than the previous). Default: `1`. |
| `ids` | array of `Id` | yes | Elements. |
| `transform` | `TransformSpec` | yes | Transformation. |

Example:

```json
{"name":"element.transform","args":{"copy":true,"count":3,"ids":[120],"transform":{"dx":0,"dy":3,"type":"move"}}}
```

### `element.copy_to_storey`

Αντιγραφή σε επίπεδο · Copy to storey

Copies elements to another storey at the same plan position.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ids` | array of `Id` | yes | Elements. |
| `storey` | `Id` | yes | Target storey. |

Example:

```json
{"name":"element.copy_to_storey","args":{"ids":[40,41,42,43],"storey":30}}
```

### `element.align`

Ευθυγράμμιση · Align

Lines up one side or the centre of elements.

Moves elements so that one side (or centre) of their plan extents lines up with the first element's, or with a given coordinate. Doors and windows follow their walls and cannot be aligned themselves.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `edge` | `AlignEdge` |  | What to line up. Default: `"left"`. |
| `ids` | array of `Id` | yes | Elements; the first is the reference unless `to` is given. |
| `to` | number or null |  | Coordinate to align to (x for left/right/centre_x, y otherwise), metres. |

Example:

```json
{"name":"element.align","args":{"edge":"bottom","ids":[60,61,62]}}
```

## opening

### `opening.place`

Τοποθέτηση ανοίγματος · Place opening

Places a door, window or void in the wall nearest to a point; the point gives the opening's centre along the wall. Sizes default to the catalogue style.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `flip_hand` | boolean |  | Swap the hinge jamb. Default: `false`. |
| `flip_side` | boolean |  | Swap the opening side. Default: `false`. |
| `height` | `Length` or null |  | Clear height; default from the style. |
| `host` | `Id` or null |  | Host wall; default: the nearest wall on `storey` within `max_distance`. |
| `kind` | `OpeningKind` | yes | Door, window or void. |
| `max_distance` | `Length` |  | How far from a wall's reference line the point may be (default 1.00 m). Default: `1.0`. |
| `params` | object |  | Style parameters. Default: `{}`. |
| `point` | `Point2` | yes | Point on or near the host wall; its projection on the wall's reference line is the opening centre. |
| `properties` | object |  | Free user properties. Default: `{}`. |
| `sill` | `Length` or null |  | Sill above the storey floor; default from the style. |
| `storey` | `Id` or null |  | Storey to search for the nearest wall (needed when `host` is not given). |
| `style` | string or null |  | Object style from the catalogue, e.g. `"window.casement_2"`; default: the kind's default style. |
| `tag` | string |  | User mark, e.g. "Π1" or "Θ2". Default: `""`. |
| `width` | `Length` or null |  | Clear width; default from the style. |

Example:

```json
{"name":"opening.place","args":{"height":1.4,"kind":"window","point":[5.0,0.0],"sill":0.9,"storey":28,"style":"window.casement_2","tag":"Θ1","width":1.2}}
```

{"name":"project.set_info","args":{"info":{"date":"Οκτώβριος 2026","designer":"Στέλιος Παραδειγματάκης","location":"Οδός Λεμονιάς 7","municipality":"Δήμος Δειγματούπολης","name":"Νέα διώροφη κατοικία","owner":"Μαρίνα Δοκιμάκη","revision":"0"}}}

## roof

### `roof.from_walls`

Στέγη από τοίχους · Roof from walls

Adds a flat or pitched roof over the walls, with an overhang.

Adds a roof over the walls of a storey: the outer faces plus an overhang, flat or pitched.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `base` | `Length` or null |  | Height of the roof's top surface at the eaves above the storey's floor; default: resting on the tallest wall of the storey. |
| `build_up` | `Id` or null |  | Build-up; default: the pitched-roof or flat-roof default. |
| `kind` | `RoofKind` |  | Shape (default hip). Default: `"hip"`. |
| `overhang` | `Length` |  | Overhang beyond the outer wall faces (default 0.50 m; 0 for none). Default: `0.5`. |
| `parapet` | `Parapet` or null |  | Parapet of a flat roof (none by default). |
| `pitch` | number |  | Pitch of sloped edges in degrees (default 25°). Default: `25.0`. |
| `storey` | `Id` | yes | Storey whose walls the roof covers; the roof is placed on it. |
| `tag` | string |  | User mark. Default: `""`. |

Example:

```json
{"name":"roof.from_walls","args":{"kind":"hip","overhang":0.6,"pitch":22,"storey":30}}
```

{"name":"sheet.update","args":{"sheet":{"id":221,"name":"Διάγραμμα κάλυψης","number":"Α-01","paper":{"landscape":true,"size":{"type":"a3"}},"viewports":[{"centre":[215,163],"view":34}]}}}

### `sheet.place_view`

Τοποθέτηση όψης σε φύλλο · Place view on sheet

Places a view on a sheet as a new viewport.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `centre` | array or null |  | Centre on the sheet in millimetres from the lower-left corner; default: the middle of the drawing area. |
| `crop` | array or null |  | Model-space crop rectangle (two opposite corners). |
| `scale` | integer or null |  | Scale override; default: the view's scale. |
| `sheet` | `Id` | yes | Sheet. |
| `title` | string or null |  | Title under the viewport; default: the view name. |
| `view` | `Id` | yes | View to place (any 2D view; 3D views cannot be placed yet). |

Example:

```json
{"name":"sheet.place_view","args":{"centre":[120,160],"scale":200,"sheet":221,"view":33}}
```

### `sheet.move_viewport`

Μετακίνηση παραθύρου όψης · Move viewport

Moves a viewport on its sheet.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `centre` | array of number | yes | New centre in millimetres from the sheet's lower-left corner. |
| `index` | integer or null |  | Viewport index on the sheet (0-based). |
| `sheet` | `Id` | yes | Sheet. |
| `view` | `Id` or null |  | Or: the view the viewport shows (the first viewport showing it). |

Example:

```json
{"name":"sheet.move_viewport","args":{"centre":[120,215],"index":0,"sheet":225}}
```

### `sheet.remove_viewport`

Αφαίρεση παραθύρου όψης · Remove viewport

Removes a viewport from its sheet (the view itself stays).

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `index` | integer or null |  | Viewport index on the sheet (0-based). |
| `sheet` | `Id` | yes | Sheet. |
| `view` | `Id` or null |  | Or: the view the viewport shows (the first viewport showing it). |

Example:

```json
{"name":"sheet.remove_viewport","args":{"sheet":225,"view":202}}
```

## site

### `site.set`

Οικόπεδο και όροι δόμησης · Plot and building terms

Replaces the whole site: plot, street and building lines, building terms, georeferencing, terrain.

Replaces the site: plot, street and building lines, building terms, georeferencing, terrain.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `site` | `Site` | yes | New site. |

Example:

```json
{"name":"site.set","args":{"site":{"ground_level":-0.3,"plot":[[-4,-6],[16,-6],[16,19],[-4,19]],"street_lines":[[[-4,-6],[16,-6]]],"terms":{"building_coefficient":0.8,"coverage_ratio":0.6,"max_floors":2,"max_height":7.5}}}}
```

### `site.set_plot`

Όρια οικοπέδου · Plot boundary

Sets or removes the plot boundary, keeping the rest of the site.

Sets (or removes, with `null`) the plot boundary, keeping the rest of the site.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `plot` | `Polygon2` or null |  | Plot boundary in project coordinates, or `null` to remove it. |

Example:

```json
{"name":"site.set_plot","args":{"plot":[[-4,-6],[16,-6],[16,19],[-4,19]]}}
```

### `site.set_terms`

Όροι δόμησης · Building terms

Sets the building terms, keeping the rest of the site.

Sets the building terms (όροι δόμησης), keeping the rest of the site.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `terms` | `BuildingTerms` | yes | Building terms. |

Example:

```json
{"name":"site.set_terms","args":{"terms":{"building_coefficient":0.8,"coverage_ratio":0.6,"max_floors":2,"max_height":7.5}}}
```

## slab

### `slab.from_walls`

Πλάκα από τοίχους · Slab from walls

Adds a slab outlined by the walls' outer or core faces.

Adds a slab on a storey whose outline follows the outside of the storey's walls.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `build_up` | `Id` or null |  | Build-up; default: the ground-slab default on the lowest storey, the floor-slab default elsewhere. |
| `face` | `OutlineFace` |  | Wall face the outline follows (default `core`: the slab edge sits behind the external insulation). Default: `"core"`. |
| `holes` | array of `Polygon2` |  | Openings through the slab (stair wells, shafts), inside the outline. Default: `[]`. |
| `storey` | `Id` | yes | Storey whose walls give the outline; the slab is placed on it. |
| `tag` | string |  | User mark. Default: `""`. |
| `top_offset` | `Length` |  | Top surface relative to the storey's floor (default 0). Default: `0.0`. |

Example:

```json
{"name":"slab.from_walls","args":{"face":"core","holes":[[[7.665,6.4],[9.835,6.4],[9.835,9.69],[7.665,9.69]]],"storey":30}}
```

## space

### `space.detect`

Νέος χώρος · New space

Creates a space from the walls enclosing a point.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `category` | `SpaceCategory` |  | Category. Default: `"main_use"`. |
| `name` | string | yes | Name. |
| `number` | string |  | Number. Default: `""`. |
| `point` | `Point2` | yes | A point inside the room. |
| `storey` | `Id` | yes | Storey. |

Example:

```json
{"name":"space.detect","args":{"category":"main_use","name":"Καθιστικό","number":"0.01","point":[3.0,3.0],"storey":28}}
```

### `space.detect_all`

Αυτόματοι χώροι · Detect all spaces

Creates a space in every room closed by walls on a storey.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `category` | `SpaceCategory` |  | Category of the new spaces (default main use). Default: `"main_use"`. |
| `locale` | `Locale` |  | Language of default names. Default: `"el"`. |
| `name` | string or null |  | Name of the new spaces; default "Χώρος n" / "Space n". |
| `numbered` | boolean |  | Number the new spaces by storey, e.g. "1.03" on the first floor (default true). Default: `true`. |
| `skip_existing` | boolean |  | Leave rooms that already contain a space alone (default true). Default: `true`. |
| `storey` | `Id` | yes | Storey. |

Example:

```json
{"name":"space.detect_all","args":{"category":"main_use","locale":"el","storey":30}}
```

## storey

### `storey.create`

Νέο επίπεδο · New storey

Adds a storey and its plan view.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `below_ground` | boolean |  | Below ground. Default: `false`. |
| `cut_height` | `Length` or null |  | Plan cut height above the floor (default 1.10 m). |
| `elevation` | `Length` | yes | Finished floor elevation above project zero. |
| `height` | `Length` | yes | Floor-to-floor height. |
| `name` | string | yes | Display name. |
| `plan_name` | string or null |  | Name of the plan view; defaults to "Κάτοψη <name>". |

Example:

```json
{"name":"storey.create","args":{"elevation":6.4,"height":3.0,"name":"Δώμα"}}
```

### `storey.update`

Αλλαγή επιπέδου · Change storey

Changes a storey's name, elevation, height or cut height.

Changes a storey. Only the given fields change.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `below_ground` | boolean or null |  | New below-ground flag. |
| `cut_height` | `Length` or null |  | New cut height. |
| `elevation` | `Length` or null |  | New elevation. |
| `height` | `Length` or null |  | New height. |
| `id` | `Id` | yes | Storey. |
| `name` | string or null |  | New name. |
| `shift_above` | boolean |  | When the height changes, move the storeys above by the same amount. Default: `false`. |

Example:

```json
{"name":"storey.update","args":{"height":3.4,"id":30,"shift_above":true}}
```

### `storey.delete`

Διαγραφή επιπέδου · Delete storey

Removes a storey with all its elements and its plan view.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `Id` | yes | Storey. |

Example:

```json
{"name":"storey.delete","args":{"id":30}}
```

### `storey.duplicate`

Αντιγραφή επιπέδου · Duplicate storey

Copies a storey with its elements, by default directly above it.

Copies a storey with all its elements and its plan view. By default the copy goes directly above the original and the storeys above move up by the original's height.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `elevation` | `Length` or null |  | Floor elevation of the copy; default: the top of the original. |
| `id` | `Id` | yes | Storey to copy. |
| `locale` | `Locale` |  | Language of default names. Default: `"el"`. |
| `name` | string or null |  | Name of the copy; default "<name> - αντίγραφο". |
| `shift_above` | boolean |  | Move the storeys at or above the copy's elevation up by its height (default true). Default: `true`. |

Example:

```json
{"name":"storey.duplicate","args":{"id":30,"name":"2ος όροφος"}}
```

Changes a view. Only the given fields change.

Αντιγραφή όψης σχεδίου · Duplicate view

## wall

### `wall.split`

Διαίρεση τοίχου · Split wall

Splits a straight wall in two at the point closest to `at`. Openings stay with the part that contains their centre.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `at` | `Point2` | yes | Split point (projected onto the wall's reference line). |
| `id` | `Id` | yes | Wall. |

Example:

```json
{"name":"wall.split","args":{"at":[4.0,0.0],"id":40}}
```

### `wall.join`

Ένωση τοίχων · Join walls

Extends or trims two walls so that they meet at a corner.

Extends or trims two straight walls so that their reference lines meet at a corner. The end of each wall nearer to the corner moves; doors and windows keep their place in the world.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `first` | `Id` | yes | First wall. |
| `second` | `Id` | yes | Second wall. |

Example:

```json
{"name":"wall.join","args":{"first":40,"second":41}}
```

## Shared types

| Type | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `AlignEdge` | Which side of the elements' bounding boxes to line up. One of `"left"`, `"right"`, `"bottom"`, `"top"`, `"centre_x"`, `"centre_y"`. |
| `Anchor` | Text anchor: which point of the text box sits at the text position. One of `"bottom_left"`, `"bottom_centre"`, `"bottom_right"`, `"middle_left"`, `"centre"`, `"middle_right"`, `"top_left"`, `"top_centre"`, `"top_right"`. |
| `Angle` | An angle in radians. Counter-clockwise is positive; zero points along +X (east in plan). number |
| `Arc2` | A circular arc, counter-clockwise from `start` by `sweep` (negative sweep runs clockwise). Fields: `centre` (`Point2`), `radius` (`Length`), `start` (`Angle`), `sweep` (`Angle`). |
| `Beam` | A horizontal beam. Fields: `end` (`Point2`), `material` (`Id`), `profile` (`Profile`), `start` (`Point2`), `top_offset` (`Length`). |
| `BuildUp` | An ordered set of layers (διαστρωμάτωση). Walls list layers left face → right face; slabs and roofs top → bottom. Fields: `id` (`Id`), `layers` (array of `BuildUpLayer`), `name` (string), `usage` (`BuildUpUsage`). |
| `BuildUpLayer` | One layer of a build-up. Fields: `core` (boolean), `material` (`Id`), `thickness` (`Length`). |
| `BuildUpUsage` | What a build-up is meant for (used to filter choices in the interface). One of `"wall"`, `"slab"`, `"roof"`, `"any"`. |
| `BuildingTerms` | Building terms of the plot (όροι δόμησης). Fields: `building_coefficient` (number), `coverage_ratio` (number), `max_floors` (integer or null), `max_height` (`Length`), `setback` (`Length` or null), `volume_coefficient` (number or null). |
| `Camera` | A 3D camera. Fields: `eye` (`Point3`), `fov` (number), `parallel` (boolean), `target` (`Point3`). |
| `Column` | A vertical column. Fields: `base_offset` (`Length`), `height` (`Length`), `material` (`Id`), `position` (`Point2`), `profile` (`Profile`), `rotation` (`Angle`). |
| `Defaults` | Default attributes used by tools when creating new elements. Fields: `exterior_wall` (`Id` or null), `flat_roof` (`Id` or null), `floor_slab` (`Id` or null), `ground_slab` (`Id` or null), `interior_wall` (`Id` or null), `pitched_roof` (`Id` or null), `railing_material` (`Id` or null), `structural_material` (`Id` or null). |
| `Dimension` | A linear dimension chain. Fields: `direction` (`Angle`), `line_point` (`Point2`), `points` (array of `Point2`). |
| `DraftShape` | Geometry of a drafting item. Variants (`type`): `line`, `polyline`, `arc`, `circle`, `fill`. |
| `DraftStyle` | Appearance of a drafting item. Fields: `background` (`Rgba` or null), `color` (`Rgba`), `hatch` (`HatchPattern`), `pattern` (`LinePattern`), `weight_mm` (number). |
| `Drafting` | A 2D drafting item (lines, arcs, fills) in a plan or another view. Fields: `shape` (`DraftShape`), `style` (`DraftStyle`). |
| `Drawing` | A complete drawing. Fields: `items` (array of `Item`), `scale` (number), `units` (`DrawingUnits`). |
| `DrawingUnits` | Coordinate units of a drawing. One of `"metres"`, `"millimetres"`. |
| `ElementKind` | Type-specific data of an element. Variants (`type`): `wall`, `slab`, `column`, `beam`, `opening`, `stair`, `roof`, `railing`, `space`, `object`, `dimension`, `text`, `level`, `drafting`, `grid`, `underlay`. |
| `Fill` | Fill of a closed area. |
| `Georef` | Link between project coordinates and a national grid. Fields: `altitude` (number), `easting` (number), `epsg` (integer), `northing` (number), `rotation` (`Angle`). |
| `GridLine` | A grid line (άξονας κανάβου), shown on every plan. Fields: `end` (`Point2`), `label` (string), `start` (`Point2`). |
| `HatchPattern` | Hatch patterns for cut materials and surfaces. Spacing is in paper millimetres, so hatches read the same at every scale. One of `"none"`, `"diagonal"`, `"masonry"`, `"cross_diagonal"`, `"concrete"`, `"insulation"`, `"wood"`, `"grid"`, `"dots"`, `"earth"`, `"gravel"`, `"horizontal"`. |
| `Id` | Stable identifier of anything in a document. Never reused within a document. integer |
| `Item` | One drawn thing. Fields: `fill` (`Fill` or null), `layer` (string), `shape` (`Shape`), `source` (integer or null), `stroke` (`Stroke` or null). |
| `Length` | A length in metres. number |
| `LevelMark` | A level mark (στάθμη). In plans it shows a floor level; in sections and elevations a height. Fields: `label` (string), `position` (`Point2`), `value` (`Length` or null). |
| `LinePattern` | Dash pattern of a stroke. Lengths are paper millimetres. One of `"solid"`, `"dashed"`, `"hidden"`, `"dotted"`, `"dash_dot"`, `"dash_dot_dot"`. |
| `Locale` | User interface locale for number formatting and text. One of `"el"`, `"en"`. |
| `Material` | A physical material with its drawing appearance. Fields: `category` (`MaterialCategory`), `color` (`Rgba`), `conductivity` (number or null), `cut_background` (`Rgba` or null), `cut_pattern` (`HatchPattern`), `density` (number or null), `id` (`Id`), `name` (string), `priority` (integer). |
| `MaterialCategory` | Broad family of a material. One of `"concrete"`, `"masonry"`, `"insulation"`, `"plaster"`, `"stone"`, `"tile"`, `"wood"`, `"metal"`, `"glass"`, `"membrane"`, `"screed"`, `"gravel"`, `"soil"`, `"air"`, `"board"`, `"other"`. |
| `Object` | A placed object from the catalogue: furniture, sanitary fixture, kitchen unit, equipment. Fields: `definition` (string), `elevation` (`Length`), `mirrored` (boolean), `params` (object), `position` (`Point2`), `rotation` (`Angle`). |
| `Opening` | A door, window or empty opening in a wall.  Position is measured along the host wall's reference line from its start to the opening's centre. Fields: `flip_hand` (boolean), `flip_side` (boolean), `height` (`Length`), `host` (`Id`), `kind` (`OpeningKind`), `offset` (`Length`), `params` (object), `sill` (`Length`), `style` (string), `width` (`Length`). |
| `OpeningKind` | What an opening is. One of `"door"`, `"window"`, `"void"`. |
| `OutlineFace` | Which wall face an outline follows. One of `"outer"`, `"core"`. |
| `Paper` | A sheet's paper. Fields: `landscape` (boolean), `size` (`PaperSize`). |
| `PaperSize` | ISO 216 A-series paper sizes, or a custom size. Variants (`type`): `a0`, `a1`, `a2`, `a3`, `a4`, `custom`. |
| `Parapet` | A parapet around a flat roof. Fields: `height` (`Length`), `thickness` (`Length`). |
| `Phase` | Construction status of an element, used for alteration drawings. One of `"new"`, `"existing"`, `"demolished"`. |
| `Point2` | A plan point [x, y] in metres (x east, y north). array of number |
| `Point3` | A point in space, metres. Serialises as `{"x":…, "y":…, "z":…}`. Fields: `x` (number), `y` (number), `z` (number). |
| `Polygon2` | A simple polygon (no self-intersections), as a closed ring of vertices without repeating the first one. Serialises as a list of `[x, y]` pairs. array of `Point2` |
| `PolygonWithHoles` | A polygon with holes, e.g. a slab outline with shafts. Serialises as `{"outer": [...], "holes": [[...]]}`. Fields: `holes` (array of `Polygon2`), `outer` (`Polygon2`). |
| `Profile` | Cross-section of a column or beam. Variants (`type`): `rectangle`, `circle`. |
| `ProjectInfo` | Project information printed in title blocks and reports. Fields: `date` (string), `designer` (string), `designer_details` (string), `location` (string), `municipality` (string), `name` (string), `notes` (string), `owner` (string), `revision` (string). |
| `Pt` | A point in drawing coordinates. Fields: `x` (number), `y` (number). |
| `Railing` | A railing along a path. Fields: `base_offset` (`Length`), `height` (`Length`), `infill` (`RailingInfill`), `material` (`Id`), `path` (array of `Point2`), `post_spacing` (`Length`). |
| `RailingInfill` | Infill of a railing. One of `"bars"`, `"glass"`, `"solid"`. |
| `ReferenceLine` | Where a wall's reference line sits relative to its thickness. One of `"left"`, `"centre"`, `"right"`. |
| `Rgba` | An RGBA colour, 8 bits per channel. Fields: `a` (integer), `b` (integer), `g` (integer), `r` (integer). |
| `Roof` | A roof over an outline (eaves line, including the overhang). Fields: `base` (`Length`), `outline` (`Polygon2`), `shape` (`RoofShape`), `structure` (`Structure`). |
| `RoofKind` | Shape of a roof made by `roof.from_walls`. One of `"hip"`, `"gable"`, `"mono"`, `"flat"`. |
| `RoofShape` | Geometry rule of a roof. Variants (`type`): `flat`, `pitched`. |
| `ScheduleKind` | Which schedule a schedule view shows. One of `"doors"`, `"windows"`, `"spaces"`, `"walls"`, `"slabs"`, `"materials"`, `"objects"`. |
| `Shape` | Geometry of a drawing item. Variants (`type`): `line`, `polyline`, `polygon`, `arc`, `circle`, `text`. |
| `Sheet` | A printable sheet. Fields: `id` (`Id`), `name` (string), `number` (string), `paper` (`Paper`), `title_block` (boolean), `viewports` (array of `Viewport`). |
| `Site` | The plot and its context. Fields: `building_lines` (array of array of `Point2`), `georef` (`Georef`), `ground_level` (`Length`), `plot` (`Polygon2` or null), `street_lines` (array of array of `Point2`), `terms` (`BuildingTerms`), `terrain` (array of `Point3`). |
| `Slab` | A floor, ceiling or other horizontal slab. Build-up layers are listed from top to bottom. Fields: `outline` (`PolygonWithHoles`), `structure` (`Structure`), `top_offset` (`Length`). |
| `Space` | A space (room), bounded by walls or drawn by hand. Fields: `boundary` (`PolygonWithHoles`), `category` (`SpaceCategory`), `finish` (string), `height` (`Length` or null), `name` (string), `number` (string), `stamp` (`Point2` or null). |
| `SpaceCategory` | Use category of a space, as needed for the Greek building code (ΝΟΚ, ν. 4067/2012) area calculations. One of `"main_use"`, `"auxiliary"`, `"stairwell"`, `"lift_shaft"`, `"semi_open"`, `"balcony"`, `"pilotis"`, `"parking"`, `"attic"`, `"technical"`, `"shaft"`, `"other"`. |
| `Stair` | A stair.  `origin` is the midpoint of the front edge of the first step; `direction` is the walking direction up the first flight. Fields: `base_offset` (`Length`), `direction` (`Angle`), `first_flight_risers` (integer or null), `gap` (`Length`), `going` (`Length`), `material` (`Id`), `origin` (`Point2`), `rise` (`Length`), `risers` (integer), `shape` (`StairShape`), `thickness` (`Length`), `width` (`Length`). |
| `StairShape` | Plan shape of a stair. One of `"straight"`, `"quarter_turn_left"`, `"quarter_turn_right"`, `"half_turn_left"`, `"half_turn_right"`. |
| `Stroke` | How an outline is stroked. Fields: `color` (`Rgba`), `pattern` (`LinePattern`), `weight_mm` (number). |
| `Structure` | What a layered element is made of. Variants (`type`): `basic`, `layered`. |
| `Text` | A single line of text. Fields: `anchor` (`Anchor`), `bold` (boolean), `color` (`Rgba`), `content` (string), `height_mm` (number), `position` (`Pt`), `rotation` (number). |
| `TextAlign` | Horizontal text alignment of a text note. One of `"left"`, `"centre"`, `"right"`. |
| `TextNote` | A text note. Several lines are separated by `\n`. Fields: `align` (`TextAlign`), `bold` (boolean), `content` (string), `position` (`Point2`), `rotation` (`Angle`), `size_mm` (number). |
| `TransformSpec` | A geometric transformation in plan. Variants (`type`): `move`, `rotate`, `mirror`. |
| `Underlay` | An imported reference drawing (e.g. a DXF survey), in project coordinates. Fields: `drawing` (`Drawing`), `name` (string), `source` (string). |
| `ViewKind` | What a view shows. Variants (`type`): `plan`, `section`, `elevation`, `three_d`, `site_plan`, `coverage_diagram`, `area_table`, `schedule`. |
| `Viewport` | A view placed on a sheet. Fields: `centre` (array of number), `crop` (array or null), `scale` (integer or null), `title` (string or null), `view` (`Id`). |
| `Wall` | A wall: straight, or a circular arc when `bulge` is non-zero.  Build-up layers are listed from the wall's **left** face to its **right** face, looking from start to end. Fields: `base_offset` (`Length`), `bulge` (number), `end` (`Point2`), `height` (`Length`), `reference` (`ReferenceLine`), `start` (`Point2`), `structure` (`Structure`). |
